blocks.text: Supply contract for laboratory equipment
No. СЛ-16/2025 dated 01 October 2025, Moscow

ООО «SpektrLab Komplekt», hereinafter referred to as the Supplier, represented by General Director Mikhail Andreevich Lebedev, and АО «Center for Applied Measurements», hereinafter referred to as the Customer, represented by General Director Irina Viktorovna Sokolova, have entered into this contract.
1 Subject of the contract

1.1. The Supplier transfers equipment for outfitting the laboratory of physical and chemical control. The assortment, quantity, completeness and prices are established by specification No. 1 dated 01.10.2025. The specification contains separate sheets “Equipment” and “Works” and is an appendix to the contract.

1.2. The scope of obligations includes supply of equipment, installation, commissioning and training of a group of employees. The Customer orders transportation separately from the carrier under request ТР-58. Certification of the work area and additional grounding works are not included in the price of this contract.

1.3. One set of micropipettes МП-3 includes three micropipettes of different ranges. Upon transfer, the set may be accounted for per piece. The price of one set equals the sum of the prices of the three micropipettes transferred as part of it.
2 Price and settlements

2.1. The initial contract price is 1 850 160,00 руб., including VAT 20% in the amount of 308 360,00 руб. The cost of equipment is 1 736 160,00 руб., the cost of works is 114 000,00 руб. Any price change shall be formalized by an additional agreement of the parties.

2.2. The Customer transfers an advance payment in the amount of 900 000,00 руб. The remaining payments are made in parts as equipment and works are accepted. The payment purpose shall indicate the contract number and date. A payment without the contract number is allocated after written agreement of the parties.

2.3. The cost of works includes the contractor's labor for billable hours. Training is paid for based on the actual duration of the session for the entire group. The number of attendees does not affect the hourly rate.
2.4. The supplier's invoice serves as the basis for transfer of funds. Performance of obligations is confirmed by documents on transfer of equipment or acceptance of completed works.
3 Supply
3.1. Supply in several batches is permitted. The initial deadline for transfer of all equipment is 24.10.2025. For each batch, a waybill is issued with the contract number, date, quantity and amount.
3.2. Place of transfer of the equipment — Kaluga, Instrumentalnaya St., 7, building 2, laboratory warehouse No. 2. The person responsible for acceptance is Warehouse Manager Kirill Andreevich Volkov.
4 Acceptance and returns

4.1. The Customer checks the quantity, completeness and visible condition of the equipment upon transfer. The fact of receipt is reflected in the waybill. Posting the equipment to warehouse records is formalized by a separate goods receipt note.

4.2. If defects are identified, the parties draw up a report indicating the model, serial number and quantity. The return is formalized by a separate document. From the moment the Supplier accepts the return, the cost of the transferred equipment is reduced by the cost of the returned units, including the corresponding VAT.
4.3. A duplicate copy of the waybill with the same number, date, composition and amount relates to one transfer transaction. The original and the accounting copy do not constitute two supplies.

4.4. Installation and commissioning works are formalized by separate reports. The scope of commissioning is indicated by verified units. The readiness of the instrument for testing is reflected in correspondence, and completion of testing — in a protocol or report.
5 Warranty and support

5.1. The warranty period for the equipment is 36 months from the date of transfer of the relevant unit under the delivery note. In the event of return of a defective unit and subsequent replacement, the period for the new unit shall be calculated from the date of its transfer.
5.2. The Supplier transfers passports and operating instructions. For scales ВА-220, a calibration certificate indicating the serial number and metrological characteristics shall be transferred.

5.3. The Customer shall notify of a malfunction by letter with a description of the manifestation, model, and serial number. The Parties shall separately agree on the method of remedy and the сроки of transfer of service documents.
6 Documents and amendments

6.1. The Parties recognize text copies of documents for operational reconciliation. For final acceptance, copies signed by the Parties shall be used. Changes to the assortment, price, and сроки shall be formalized by supplementary agreements with reference to this contract.

6.2. In the event of a contradiction between the initial specification and a subsequent supplementary agreement, the expressly amended terms of the supplementary agreement shall apply. The remaining terms shall continue in force.
7 Parties' details
From the supplier /M. A. Lebedev/ From the customer /I. V. Sokolova/

ООО “SpektrLab Komplekt” and АО “Center for Applied Measurements” agreed on a change in the price of item EQ-04 and the delivery period for the equipment. The changes apply to batches transferred under the contract after the signing of this agreement.
1 Specification amendment

Item EQ-04 “Magnetic Stirrer MM-2” in the quantity of 8 шт. shall be paid at the price of 14 250,00 руб. per unit excluding VAT instead of 15 000,00 руб. The cost of the item is 114 000,00 руб. excluding VAT and 136 800,00 руб. including VAT 20%. The quantity and model are unchanged.
2 Delivery period
The final delivery period for all equipment under clause 3.1 of the contract is set as 30.10.2025. Delivery in batches is permitted within the specified period.
3 Contract price

The contract price after a reduction of 7 200,00 руб. is 1 842 960,00 руб., including VAT 20% in the amount of 307 160,00 руб. The cost of the equipment is 1 728 960,00 руб., the cost of the work is 114 000,00 руб.
The agreement enters into force from the date of signing by both parties. Other terms of the contract shall apply in the current version.
From the supplier /M. A. Lebedev/ From the customer /I. V. Sokolova/
Certificate of completed installation works
No. 62 dated 27 October 2025 under contract СЛ-16/2025

Contractor ООО «SpektrLab Komplekt». Customer АО «Center for Applied Measurements». Place of work — laboratory No. 2, Kaluga, 7 Instrumentalnaya St., building 2. Work performance period from 24 to 27 October 2025.
Completed works
The equipment was placed at prepared workstations. Free access to ventilation openings, the routing of network cables, and the possibility of servicing the instruments were checked.

Assembly and leveling of supports were completed, the instruments were connected to existing electrical outlets, standard accessories were installed, and the completeness of the workstations was checked.

Platforms with vibration limitation were prepared for the scales. The centrifuges were secured on designated tables. The mechanical lid locks were checked without carrying out the technological cycle.

The thermostats were installed at the workstations. Completion of installation means readiness for subsequent commissioning tests. The results of these tests are documented by a commissioning certificate.
Installation of an additional grounding circuit is not included in the scope of this certificate. The contractor used the existing power supply lines and protective conductor.

The actual time is recorded in the work log for each day. Acceptance was completed by the customer's representative after inspection of the workstations. There are no remarks regarding the listed installation operations.
The cost calculation and distribution of hours are provided on the next page and form part of this certificate.
Calculation of accepted works
The cost of accepted installation works amounts to 42 000,00 руб without VAT. VAT 20% amounts to 8 400,00 руб. Total payable under the certificate: 50 400,00 руб.

The customer accepted the listed works in the amount of 28 hours. The calculation relates to the labor of the contractor's personnel and does not include the cost of supplied equipment, transportation, and commissioning.
From the supplier /M. A. Lebedev/ From the customer /I. V. Sokolova/

Outgoing No. 173 dated 31 October 2025
To the General Director of АО «Center for Applied Measurements» I. V. Sokolova
Dear Irina Viktorovna!

We hereby inform you of the readiness of thermostat ТС-80, serial number ТС80-25102, for operation after adjustment of the door seal. The equipment was transferred under delivery note No. 426 dated 20.10.2025 under contract СЛ-16/2025.

This unit was not included in commissioning report No. 64 dated 29.10.2025, since the adjustment was performed after completion of the engineer's general visit. Verification of the temperature regime is carried out separately.

We will provide the control run protocol with measurements and the customer's representative's mark by 05.11.2025. We kindly ask you to coordinate the time of access to the laboratory for formalizing the results.
Service engineer Petr Nikolaevich Zotov is ready to provide explanations regarding the completed adjustment. Contact for the training kit — service@spectrlab.example.
General Director /M. A. Lebedev/
